Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
657 PM EST Sat Nov 21 2026

.TONIGHT...NE winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft or less. 
.SUN...NE winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 1 ft. Rain.
.SUN NIGHT...N winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming W 5 to 10 kt after
midnight. Waves 1 ft. Rain likely. 
.MON...NW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 15 to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.TUE...N winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.TUE NIGHT...NE winds 15 to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.WED...NE winds 15 to 20 kt...increasing to 25 to 30 kt. Waves 2 to
3 ft...building to 4 ft after midnight. Rain likely after midnight. 
.THU...N winds 25 to 30 kt. Waves 4 ft. Rain through the day, then a
chance of rain through the night.
